title: SQLi in login handler
summary: A login route that concatenates user input directly into SQL queries, making it vulnerable to SQL injection attacks.

title: XSS in template output
summary: User input is rendered directly in HTML templates without sanitization, allowing cross-site scripting attacks.

title: Weak encryption implementation
summary: The application uses deprecated cryptographic algorithms and weak key derivation functions.

title: Session fixation vulnerability
summary: Session identifiers are not regenerated after authentication, allowing attackers to hijack user sessions.

title: Unsafe deserialization
summary: User-controlled data is deserialized without validation, potentially leading to remote code execution.
